stance_rationale: v3 fixed the prior RF-A7 time-series alpha shape and current C13/C14/C15 loader path, but the package still fails hard liquidity, AX-007, RF-A6 methodology, monotonicity/sector-neutral checks, and No Silent Override lineage consistency. Numeric IC pass claims are therefore not deployable evidence.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT-D20260429_001/alpha_scores.parquet has Date x Ticker x alpha_z over 279 monthly signal dates, month-end aligned, last date <= 2026-04-29, and time-varying ticker counts.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: factor_engine_v3.R calls load_month_factors(sig_date), and factor_db_connector.R returns Z_Score_Aligned.
align_factor_direction() filters IC history by Usable_Date <= sig_date before direction alignment.
current v3 package path uses load_month_factors() for factor DB access; v1/v2 direct parquet files are stale artifacts.
No financial-statement factor is used; proxies are price/volatility based.

critical_concerns.description: AX-007 is not actually satisfied: the package labels regime-conditional weighting as an exception, but base AX-007 exceptions are multi-sleeve, long-short, 50+ diversification, or ML sizing; a hard top-20 long-only deployment remains a single-sleeve mechanism break under L-484.

RF-A5/liquidity remains a hard fail against the base mandate: factor_engine_v3.R uses LIQ_THRESHOLD=5e7, not 2e8, and verified alpha history contains 2204 alpha observations below 2e8 plus 259 top-decile observations below 2e8 and 109 below 1e8.

RF-A6 is unresolved: Harvey t is a plain IC mean/(sd/sqrt(n)) statistic, not Newey-West HAC, DSR assumes one trial despite candidate/spec selection, and the required 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 evidence is absent.

RF-A3/RF-A4 and monotonicity checks are incomplete: package diagnostics set monotonicity to null/{}, sector-neutral decay is not measured, and alpha_validation lists RF-A3 flags for D01_IdioVol and D04_Downside_Beta without a rebuttal.

AX-008/No Silent Override is not clean: artifact_lineage.json is absent, while alpha_hypothesis.json, alpha_validation.json, and alpha_package.json disagree on selected factor, ICIR, candidates tried, and even contain stale text saying ICIR=0.637 when current composite ICIR is 0.3278.

AX-005 remains fragile because CVaR/IVOL/downside-beta is still a KR defense low-vol structure where EXCLUSION is necessary not sufficient; CF-04 admits KR-specific CVaR evidence is still needed, and L-122 warns factor timing is not risk management.

Family saturation is not closed: Q07_Earnings_Stability IC-level correlation is 0.737 and TDC/portfolio return correlation was not measured, so averaging to mean |cor|=0.273 masks an L-219-style overlap risk.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 is materially fixed in the current artifact: alpha_scores.parquet has 279 month-end signal dates and the package alpha_vector matches the 2026-03-31 slice exactly after rounding.
Current v3 factor loading is materially better than v1/v2: load_month_factors() and Usable_Date <= sig_date are present in the active path.
Reported composite rank_ic, ICIR, and subperiod stability clear the simple numeric thresholds before RF-A6 and hard-constraint invalidations are applied.

weakest_assumption: Regime-conditioned low-vol/CVaR alpha is being treated as sufficient to escape AX-007 and AX-005 for a hard top-20 long-only KR portfolio, even though it matches none of the base AX-007 exception classes.
rebuttal_required: Prove one valid AX-007 exception from the base list, or redesign as multi-sleeve, long-short, 50+ breadth, or ML sizing.
Regenerate alpha_scores with a 2e8 KRW 20d TV floor and C10-safe lag, then report top-decile liquidity by month.
Recompute Harvey t with Newey-West HAC, DSR with actual trial count/spec history, and 5-spec regression evidence.
Add monotonicity >=0.80 evidence, sector-neutral ICIR decay, and explicit handling of RF-A3 constituent flags.
Create artifact_lineage.json and reconcile stale alpha_hypothesis/alpha_validation/package inconsistencies.
Measure TDC/portfolio return correlation versus STR_1715 and provide KR-specific CVaR mechanism evidence.
